title: Externalize: jot it down, settle it tonight
description: Write down whatever pops into your head in a few words, then let it go. In the evening, each one gets an ending: do it, schedule it or drop it. Every feature is free.

app.name: Externalize
app.empty:
When something pops into your head, write it below and let it go.
Tonight you'll decide what to do with it.

problem.title: Small things still take up room in your head
problem.text: In the shower, at a red light, just as you drift off: "I need to do that thing." There's nowhere handy to write it, so you hold on to it, and whatever you were doing gets a little blurrier. To-do apps want a list and a due date first, so even writing it down turns into a chore.

features.title: Three seconds, then let go
features.text:
Open the app and type into the line at the bottom. No lists, folders or due dates to pick.
Tap the Lock Screen widget and it opens on a blank line. Say `Remember in Externalize` to Siri, or put it on the Action Button, and it's saved without opening the app.

features.title: Settle them in the evening
features.text:
If anything is still open, you get one reminder at 9 PM. Nothing open, no nudge.
Start settling and items come up one at a time, large and clear. Pick Do it now, Pick a time or Drop it and the next one appears. If it takes two minutes, start the timer and get it done.

features.title: Nothing is left to rot
features.text:
Pick In an hour, This evening, Tomorrow morning, This weekend or Next week and it comes back then. The notification lets you mark it Done, move it to Tomorrow morning or Drop it.
Anything waiting over a day, and anything you keep putting off, is marked, so the stuff that keeps slipping stands out.

items.title: Write it down
items.text: A few words in the app, on the Lock Screen widget or through Siri, whichever is closest.

items.title: Allow notifications
items.text: It asks once, the first time you write something. They carry the evening reminder and the times you pick.

items.title: Settle it tonight
items.text: Tap the reminder or Settle them now and give each item an ending.

rows: choose Done, Pick a time or Drop it
Drop it, or Schedule to pick a time

reference.note: When you pick a time, This evening means 7 PM, Tomorrow morning means 9 AM, This weekend means Saturday at 10 AM and Next week means Monday at 9 AM. You can also choose any date and time yourself.

items.q: Can I write something down without opening the app?
items.a: Yes. Say `Remember in Externalize` to Siri; it asks what's on your mind and saves it. Assign the Write It Down shortcut to the Action Button in Settings and it takes one press.

items.q: How do I add the Lock Screen widget?
items.a: Touch and hold the Lock Screen, tap Customize ▸ Lock Screen, tap the widget area and add Externalize. One tap opens the app on a blank line, and it shows how many items are left. There's a small Home Screen widget too.

items.q: Can I change or turn off the evening reminder?
items.a: Tap the gear at the top right ▸ Evening reminder to change the time or turn it off. It's 9 PM by default and stays quiet on days when nothing is open.
If Externalize's settings say notifications are off, tap the button there to turn them on in iPhone Settings. On days when nothing is open, no evening reminder is expected.

items.q: How does a scheduled item come back?
items.a: You get a notification at the time you picked. Touch and hold it to choose Done, Tomorrow morning or Drop it. If you do nothing, it goes back to On your mind and you settle it next time.

items.q: Can I bring back something I marked Done or dropped?
items.a: No. Settled items are removed from the list, and there's no archive. If you aren't sure yet, pick a time instead of dropping it.

items.q: Will my items move to a new phone?
items.a: No. Everything stays on this device and is never sent to iCloud or a server. Deleting the app deletes it too.
